evidence_text: The fourth installment in the Metroid series , it was developed by the company 's Research & Development 1 -LRB- R&D 1 -RRB- divisionthe same team that previously developed the 1994 game Super Metroid , to which Fusion bears heavy resemblance . Super Metroid is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure video game developed and published by Nintendo and released for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System in 1994 . Super Metroid was directed and written by Yoshio Sakamoto , and produced by Makoto Kano , with Gunpei Yokoi serving as general manager . Super Metroid received acclaim from critics , who praised its atmosphere , gameplay , music and graphics . Super Metroid became popular among players for speedrunning , and its gameplay and design influenced other games .
